constraints: runtime soft-weighted arm-first sampling consumes each arm queue in order
Ours collection ranks 1..25 are the verbatim promoted failures
Ours collection ranks 26..50 are the FPS fills
Ours ranks are peg-batched independently inside each 25-point half
baseline rows are paired to the Ours path to reduce peg switches
source labels hidden from the operator

operator_frame.description: Manual nut placement targets relative to the square_d2 workspace origin. +x is forward, +y is left, yaw is nut heading. The square peg is placed at the per-row peg_x/peg_y grid point.
